roles.defaultModelHint: Leave empty to follow the session
roles.safetyNote: The tool allowlist and approval policy are enforced by the runtime and the native trust boundary; a persona cannot bypass them. Enabling "Run command" still requires approval for every command — it only runs straight through when the session is in Auto mode and this role's apply policy is auto. Enabling "Drive Agent" authorizes the native Coding Agent to run tools and modify the workspace or session with elevated privileges and no per-call approval.
roles.dangerDesc: Sessions referencing this role fall back to the default role. This cannot be undone.
roles.resetDesc: Reset this built-in role's persona, tools and model to the factory state. Your custom roles are untouched.

experimental.groupDesc: These features are still being polished. They are off by default and may change between versions.
experimental.sessionOptimizationDesc: Adds the magic-wand entry to the browser: an optimizer role analyzes the session and proposes rewrites for user prompts, applied only after your confirmation. Consumes model calls.
experimental.togglesNote: These switches only control visibility and reachability; they never delete existing data. Turning one off hides its entry points right away, and any process already running stops the next time you launch the app.

builtin-agent.title: Built-in AI assistant
builtin-agent.desc: Once enabled, Ask Ferry appears in the sidebar and the Provider / model / role / skill settings are unlocked.

handoff.title: Resume in another agent
handoff.desc: Adds "Copy resume instruction" to the session context menu: paste it into any coding agent that has the ferry-resume skill and it reads the history and continues. Nothing is written to any store.

writeCheck.runtimeProbeDesc: After writing, performs a real resume on a temporary shadow session for verification (consumes one model call; cleaned up automatically, no messages appended to the live session). When off, only structure validation is performed (default).

terminal.appDesc: Auto tries Warp, iTerm2, then Terminal. If the selected app is unavailable, Ferry falls back to Terminal.

motion.reduceMotionDesc: Reduce transitions and displacement animations to lower visual distraction

guideSection.guideDesc: Replay the step-by-step walkthrough of navigation, resource pane, and migration delivery
guideSection.firstRunDesc: Replay the installation and session detection results for local tools

sources.footnote: Ferry automatically discovers session directories of supported tools on this machine. Source sessions stay read-only and are not modified.

updates.currentVersionDescWeb: In-browser preview does not support in-app updates
updates.autoCheckDesc: Checks after launch with a delay; does not auto-download or install
updates.footnote: Ferry will ask for your download and install confirmation separately. You can only install and restart after the download completes.
